name: SSHI_FullBridge
rationale: The open-circuit voltage of the piezo (approx 0.76 V) is significantly lower than the required 1.8 V output. A simple bridge rectifier (FBR) cannot boost the voltage. I am implementing a Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) topology. By switching an inductor across the piezo terminals at the voltage extrema (zero-crossings of the current), the voltage across the piezo capacitance Cp is flipped, effectively boosting the available voltage. A full-bridge rectifier then extracts this boosted energy into a storage capacitor. A small storage capacitor (470 nF) is chosen to ensure fast startup (under 0.4 s) while maintaining low ripple due to the high load resistance. A Zener diode (DZ33) is added to clamp the output and prevent it from exceeding 3.6 V under strong excitation.
